```{r DataSubwayLines, include= FALSE}
# Datensatz laden
lines <- read_dta("Data/SubwayLines.dta")

# Wie im Original Hong Kong entfernen
lines_nohk <- lines %>%
  filter(city != "Hong Kong")

lines_nohk %>%
  count(city, sort = TRUE)
```


```{r Fig1Vorbereiten, echo=FALSE}
# Datensatz urban_en für Fig 1, zuerst irrelevante Spalten entfernen

urban_fig1 <- urban_en %>%
  select(city, city_en, year, subway_length_total_km, subway_ridership_10k)


#  Aggregieren auf Jahresebene, Pendant zu diesem Stata Befehl: collapse (sum) subway_length subway_ridership, by(year)

annual_temp <- urban_fig1 %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    subway_length = sum(subway_length_total_km, na.rm = TRUE),
    subway_ridership = sum(subway_ridership_10k, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# Im Vorbild ist die Ridership in Millionen angegeben, deswegen müssen die Werte umgerechnet werden

annual_temp <- annual_temp %>%
  mutate(
    subway_ridership = subway_ridership / 100
  )


# Jahr 2009 entfernen, da es keine Ridership enthält, Datenfehler?

annual_temp <- annual_temp %>%
  filter(year != 2009)




# der Rest der Daten kommt aus SubwayLines.dta, hier lines_nohk
# Wir beginnen damit, für jedes Eröffnungsjahr die neu hinzugekommene Streckenlänge aufzusummieren

lines_year <- lines_nohk %>%
  group_by(openyear) %>%
  summarise(
    lengthkm = sum(lengthkm, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(openyear)

# Daraus bilden wir die laufende kumulative Summe, sprich die tatsächliche Länge für jedes Jahr
lines_year <- lines_year %>%
  mutate(
    subway_length2 = cumsum(lengthkm)
  )


# für merge openyear in year umbenennen

lines_year <- lines_year %>%
  rename(year = openyear) %>%
  select(year, subway_length2)


```

```{r merge fig1, echo=FALSE}
# Die beiden vorbereiteten Datensätze werden zusammengefügt, full join, damit keine Daten verloren gehen

fig1_df <- full_join(lines_year, annual_temp, by = "year") %>%
  arrange(year)


# NA Werte statt 0 wie im Stata Code

fig1_df <- fig1_df %>%
  mutate(
    subway_ridership = na_if(subway_ridership, 0),
    subway_length = na_if(subway_length, 0)
  )


# Labels von Vorbild Grafik übernehmen

fig1_df <- fig1_df %>%
  mutate(
    NCities = case_when(
      year == 2000 ~ "4 cities",
      year == 2017 ~ "30 cities",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )


# wie in originaler Grafik Begrenzung auf Jahre ab 2000
plot_df <- fig1_df %>%
  filter(year >= 2000, year <= 2017)

```

```{r plotfig1, echo=FALSE}
# ggplot benötigt einen skalierungsfaktor für die rechte achse
scale_factor <- 3.2


# Plot erstellen

p_fig1 <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = year)) +
  geom_line(
    # Graph Ridership
    data = plot_df %>% filter(year >= 2002, !is.na(subway_ridership)),
    aes(y = subway_ridership, color = "ridership"),
    linewidth = 1.1,
    lineend = "round"
  ) +
  geom_line(
    # Graph Length
    data = plot_df %>% filter(year >= 2002, !is.na(subway_length2)),
    aes(y = subway_length2 * scale_factor, color = "length"),
    linewidth = 1.1,
    linetype = "31"
  ) +
  # Achsen und Skalen konfigurieren und Skalenstriche hinzufügen
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(2000, 2005, 2010, 2015, 2020),
    limits = c(2000, 2020)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "total ridership (million)",
    breaks = c(0, 5000, 10000, 15000),
    limits = c(0, 16000),
    sec.axis = sec_axis(
      ~ . / scale_factor,
      name = "total length (km)",
      breaks = c(0, 1000, 2000, 3000, 4000, 5000)
    )
  ) +
  # Farben mit Hexpicker aus Original übernommen
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("ridership" = "#6d8d84", "length" = "#90343a"),
    breaks = c("ridership", "length")
  ) +
  # X-Achse beschriftung
  labs(
    x = "year",
    color = NULL
  ) +
  # Labels aus Original für Anzahl der Städte 2002 und 2017
  geom_text(
    data = tibble(
      x = c(2000.2, 2017.5),
      y = c(236 * scale_factor + 100, 4476 * scale_factor + 100),
      label = c("4 cities", "30 cities")
    ),
    aes(x = x, y = y, label = label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    color = "black",
    size = 2.8,
    hjust = 0,
    vjust = c(-0.1, -0.15)
  ) +
  # Legende hinzugefügt
  guides(
    color = guide_legend(
      nrow = 1,
      byrow = TRUE,
      override.aes = list(
        linewidth = c(1.3, 1.3),
        linetype = c("solid", "dashed")
      )
    )
  ) +
  # Theme mit Farben, Positionen und vertikalen Skalenbeschriftungen
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    legend.key.width = unit(2.4, "cm"),
    legend.key.height = unit(0.6, "cm"),
    legend.background = element_rect(color = "black", fill = "white", linewidth = 0.4),
    legend.box.background = element_rect(color = "black", fill = "white", linewidth = 0.4),
    legend.margin = margin(6, 10, 6, 10),
  
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.3),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
  
    axis.line.x.bottom = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.line.y.left = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.line.y.right = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.line.x.top = element_blank(),
    
    axis.text.y = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.y.right = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 0.5),
  
    axis.title.y.right = element_text(
      angle = 90,
      margin = margin(l = 12)
    ),
    # Aspect Ratio vom Original übernommen
    aspect.ratio = 0.674
  )

p_fig1
```

##### Table 1 Grafik

```{r grafik1_daten}

data_grafik1_monat <- read_dta("Data/data_table1.dta") %>%
  mutate(
    panel = factor(
      panel,
      levels = c("Panel A", "Panel B", "Panel C")
    ),
    
    opening_year = as.integer(opening_year),
    
    opening_month = if_else(
      date_precision == "day",
      as.integer(month(opening_date)),
      NA_integer_
    ),
    
    # reine Jahresangaben als eigener Stapel rechts neben Dezember
    x_plot = if_else(
      date_precision == "year",
      14L,
      opening_month
    ),
    
    line_status = case_when(
      panel == "Panel A" ~ "Newly opened lines\nAug 2016–Dec 2017",
      panel %in% c("Panel B", "Panel C") & opening_year <= 2017 ~ "Existing lines\nopening year ≤ 2017",
      panel %in% c("Panel B", "Panel C") & opening_year >= 2018 ~ "Planned lines\nopening year ≥ 2018",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    
    line_status = factor(
      line_status,
      levels = c(
        "Newly opened lines\nAug 2016–Dec 2017",
        "Existing lines\nopening year ≤ 2017",
        "Planned lines\nopening year ≥ 2018"
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(x_plot), !is.na(line_status))

# Manueller Stapel:
# unten Panel A, darüber Panel B, darüber Panel C
data_grafik1_monat_stack <- data_grafik1_monat %>%
  count(x_plot, panel, line_status, name = "n") %>%
  filter(n > 0) %>%
  group_by(x_plot) %>%
  arrange(panel, line_status, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(y_start = lag(cumsum(n), default = 0)) %>%
  uncount(n, .id = "dot_id") %>%
  mutate(y = y_start + dot_id) %>%
  ungroup()

max_y <- max(data_grafik1_monat_stack$y, na.rm = TRUE)


```

##### Table 2

```{r table2_helpers, include=FALSE}
# Kleine Hilfsfunktionen für die Replikation von Table 2.
# Die Berechnungslogik folgt ReplicaCodes/Tab2.do: CityChars.dta für Panel A
# und BaseSamp.dta mit wk2open in [-6, 47] für Panel B.
fmt_number <- function(x, digits = 0, big.mark = ",", trim_zeros = FALSE) {
  out <- formatC(
    x,
    format = "f",
    digits = digits,
    big.mark = big.mark,
    preserve.width = "none"
  )

  if (trim_zeros && digits > 0) {
    out <- sub("0+$", "", out)
    out <- sub("\\.$", "", out)
  }

  out
}

fmt_integer <- function(x) {
  formatC(x, format = "d", big.mark = ",")
}

stata_quantile <- function(x, probs) {
  # Für die Quartile nutzen wir die inverse empirische Verteilungsfunktion.
  # Das entspricht der deskriptiven Idee aus Statas summarize, detail hinreichend
  # und vermeidet Interpolation zwischen zwei Städten.
  as.numeric(quantile(x, probs = probs, na.rm = TRUE, type = 1, names = FALSE))
}
```

```{r table2_panel_a, include=FALSE}
table2_city <- read_dta("Data/CityChars.dta") %>%
  mutate(pop_million = popx10k / 100)

summarise_city_var <- function(data, variable, digits) {
  values <- data[[variable]]
  c(
    mean = round(mean(values, na.rm = TRUE), digits),
    p25 = round(stata_quantile(values, 0.25), digits),
    median = round(stata_quantile(values, 0.50), digits),
    p75 = round(stata_quantile(values, 0.75), digits)
  )
}

make_city_stats_row <- function(variable_label, group_label, treat_value, source_variable, digits) {
  group_data <- table2_city %>%
    filter(treat == treat_value)
  stats <- summarise_city_var(group_data, source_variable, digits)

  tibble(
    variable = variable_label,
    group = group_label,
    n_cities = nrow(group_data),
    digits = digits,
    mean = stats[["mean"]],
    p25 = stats[["p25"]],
    median = stats[["median"]],
    p75 = stats[["p75"]]
  )
}

city_stats <- bind_rows(
  make_city_stats_row("population (million)", "treated cities", 1, "pop_million", 2),
  make_city_stats_row("GDP per capita (yuan)", "treated cities", 1, "gdppc", 0),
  make_city_stats_row("population (million)", "control cities", 0, "pop_million", 2),
  make_city_stats_row("GDP per capita (yuan)", "control cities", 0, "gdppc", 0)
)

table2_panel_a <- city_stats %>%
  select(variable, group, n_cities, digits, mean, p25, median, p75) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = group,
    values_from = c(n_cities, digits, mean, p25, median, p75),
    names_glue = "{group}_{.value}"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      c(`treated cities_mean`, `treated cities_p25`, `treated cities_median`, `treated cities_p75`),
      ~ if_else(
        `treated cities_digits` == 0,
        fmt_number(.x, digits = 0),
        fmt_number(.x, digits = 2, trim_zeros = TRUE)
      )
    ),
    across(
      c(`control cities_mean`, `control cities_p25`, `control cities_median`, `control cities_p75`),
      ~ if_else(
        `control cities_digits` == 0,
        fmt_number(.x, digits = 0),
        fmt_number(.x, digits = 2, trim_zeros = TRUE)
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  transmute(
    variable,
    treated_mean = `treated cities_mean`,
    treated_p25 = `treated cities_p25`,
    treated_median = `treated cities_median`,
    treated_p75 = `treated cities_p75`,
    control_mean = `control cities_mean`,
    control_p25 = `control cities_p25`,
    control_median = `control cities_median`,
    control_p75 = `control cities_p75`
  )

table2_n_treated <- 25L # Table 2 zählt Foshan als eigene treated city; CityChars fasst Foshan mit Guangzhou zusammen.
table2_n_control <- unique(city_stats$n_cities[city_stats$group == "control cities"])
```

```{r table2_panel_b, include=FALSE}
table2_roads <- read_dta("Data/BaseSamp.dta") %>%
  filter(between(wk2open, -6, 47)) %>%
  mutate(
    treatment_group = if_else(treat == 1, "treated", "control"),
    road_type = factor(
      roadtype,
      levels = c(1, 2, 3, 4),
      labels = c("highways", "urban expressways", "arterial streets", "sub-arterial streets")
    )
  )

summarise_roads <- function(data, group_value, road_value = NULL) {
  sample_data <- data %>%
    filter(treatment_group == group_value)

  if (!is.null(road_value)) {
    sample_data <- sample_data %>%
      filter(road_type == road_value)
  }

  tibble(
    n_obs = nrow(sample_data),
    n_segments = n_distinct(sample_data$linkid),
    avg_speed = mean(sample_data$speed, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_congestion_index = mean(sample_data$CI, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}

road_rows <- c("all road segments", levels(table2_roads$road_type))

table2_panel_b_raw <- bind_rows(
  lapply(road_rows, function(row_name) {
    road_filter <- if (row_name == "all road segments") NULL else row_name

    bind_cols(
      tibble(road_type = row_name),
      summarise_roads(table2_roads, "treated", road_filter) %>%
        rename_with(~ paste0("treated_", .x)),
      summarise_roads(table2_roads, "control", road_filter) %>%
        rename_with(~ paste0("control_", .x))
    )
  })
)

table2_panel_b <- table2_panel_b_raw %>%
  transmute(
    road_type,
    treated_n_obs = fmt_integer(treated_n_obs),
    treated_n_segments = fmt_integer(treated_n_segments),
    treated_avg_speed = fmt_number(round(treated_avg_speed, 2), digits = 2, trim_zeros = TRUE),
    treated_avg_congestion_index = fmt_number(round(treated_avg_congestion_index, 2), digits = 2, trim_zeros = TRUE),
    control_n_obs = fmt_integer(control_n_obs),
    control_n_segments = fmt_integer(control_n_segments),
    control_avg_speed = fmt_number(round(control_avg_speed, 2), digits = 2, trim_zeros = TRUE),
    control_avg_congestion_index = fmt_number(round(control_avg_congestion_index, 2), digits = 2, trim_zeros = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r table2_original_kableextra, results='asis', echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
panel_b_out <- table2_panel_b %>%
  mutate(
    road_type = recode(
      road_type,
      "all road segments" = "All road segments",
      "highways" = "Highways",
      "urban expressways" = "Urban expressways",
      "arterial streets" = "Arterial streets",
      "sub-arterial streets" = "Subarterial streets"
    )
  ) %>%
  transmute(
    variable = road_type,
    t1 = treated_n_obs,
    t2 = treated_n_segments,
    t3 = treated_avg_speed,
    t4 = treated_avg_congestion_index,
    gap = "",
    c1 = control_n_obs,
    c2 = control_n_segments,
    c3 = control_avg_speed,
    c4 = control_avg_congestion_index
  )

# Eine gemeinsame Tabelle bauen
table2_out <- bind_rows(
  tibble(

kable(
  table2_out,
  format = "html",
```

##### Figure 2
```{r fig2_libraries, include=FALSE}
library(fixest)
library(broom)
library(purrr)
library(patchwork)
library(readr)
```

```{r fig2_data, echo=FALSE}
base_samp <- read_dta("Data/BaseSamp.dta") %>%
  filter(between(wk2open, -6, 47))

# Stata Fig2.do baut exakt diese Event-Variablen:
# Am6-Am2, A0, Ap1-Ap47 (Am1 ist ausgelassene Referenzperiode)
for (w in -6:-2) {
  nm <- paste0("Am", abs(w))
  base_samp[[nm]] <- base_samp$treat * as.numeric(base_samp$wk2open == w)
}
base_samp$A0 <- base_samp$treat * as.numeric(base_samp$wk2open == 0)
for (w in 1:47) {
  nm <- paste0("Ap", w)
  base_samp[[nm]] <- base_samp$treat * as.numeric(base_samp$wk2open == w)
}

rhs_terms <- c(paste0("Am", 6:2), "A0", paste0("Ap", 1:47))
rhs_str <- paste(rhs_terms, collapse = " + ")

# Panel A: stacked DID (wie Fig2.do)
form_a <- as.formula(
  paste0("lnspd_res ~ ", rhs_str, " + treat | linkid + case_wk2open + yrwk[lnpop] + yrwk[lngdppc]")
)
mod_fig2_a <- feols(form_a, cluster = ~case, data = base_samp)

# Panel B: TWFE, treated units only
form_b <- as.formula(
  paste0("lnspd_res ~ ", rhs_str, " | linkid + yrwk")
)
mod_fig2_b <- feols(form_b, cluster = ~case, data = base_samp %>% filter(treat == 1))

# Panel C: TWFE + differential seasonality, treated units only
form_c <- as.formula(
  paste0("lnspd_res ~ ", rhs_str, " | linkid + yrwk + yrwk[lnpop] + yrwk[lngdppc]")
)
mod_fig2_c <- feols(form_c, cluster = ~case, data = base_samp %>% filter(treat == 1))

extract_event_path <- function(model) {
  td <- broom::tidy(model)

  pre <- map_dfr(-6:-2, function(w) {
    key <- paste0("Am", abs(w))
    hit <- td %>% filter(term == key)
    tibble(
      week = w,
      estimate = hit$estimate[1],
      std_error = hit$std.error[1]
    )
  })

  ref <- tibble(week = -1, estimate = 0, std_error = 0)

  zero <- td %>% filter(term == "A0") %>%
    transmute(week = 0, estimate = estimate, std_error = std.error)

  post <- map_dfr(1:47, function(w) {
    key <- paste0("Ap", w)
    hit <- td %>% filter(term == key)
    tibble(
      week = w,
      estimate = hit$estimate[1],
      std_error = hit$std.error[1]
    )
  })

  bind_rows(pre, ref, zero, post) %>%
    mutate(
      ci_low = estimate - 1.96 * std_error,
      ci_high = estimate + 1.96 * std_error
    )
}

fig2_a_df <- extract_event_path(mod_fig2_a)
fig2_b_df <- extract_event_path(mod_fig2_b)
fig2_c_df <- extract_event_path(mod_fig2_c)

plot_fig2_panel <- function(df, panel_title) {
  ggplot(df, aes(x = week, y = estimate)) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = ci_low, ymax = ci_high), width = 0, color = "#6d8d84", linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_point(color = "#6d8d84", size = 1.7) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "#a63d40", linewidth = 0.6) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(-8, 48, 4), limits = c(-8, 48)) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(-0.05, 0.1, 0.05), limits = c(-0.055, 0.105)) +
    labs(title = panel_title, x = "Weeks to subway opening", y = "Coefficient") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0, face = "plain"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
}

p_fig2_a <- plot_fig2_panel(fig2_a_df, "Panel A. Stacked DID")
p_fig2_b <- plot_fig2_panel(fig2_b_df, "Panel B. Two-way fixed effects, not accounting for seasonality")
p_fig2_c <- plot_fig2_panel(fig2_c_df, "Panel C. Two-way fixed effects, accounting for seasonality")
```

##### Table 4

```{r table4_varying_preperiod, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
tab4_data <- read_dta("Data/BaseSamp.dta") %>%
  mutate(
    post = as.numeric(wk2open >= 0),
    TP = treat * post,
    wkabs = abs(wk2open),
    wk2open_pre_treat = wkabs * (post == 0) * treat,
    wk2open_post_treat = wkabs * (post == 1) * treat,
    wk2open2_pre_treat = wkabs^2 * (post == 0) * treat,
    wk2open2_post_treat = wkabs^2 * (post == 1) * treat,
    wk2open3_pre_treat = wkabs^3 * (post == 0) * treat,
    wk2open3_post_treat = wkabs^3 * (post == 1) * treat,
    wk2open4_pre_treat = wkabs^4 * (post == 0) * treat,
    wk2open4_post_treat = wkabs^4 * (post == 1) * treat,
    wk2open5_pre_treat = wkabs^5 * (post == 0) * treat,
    wk2open5_post_treat = wkabs^5 * (post == 1) * treat
  )

run_tab4 <- function(data, pre_weeks = 48L, poly_degree = 0L) {
  data_use <- data %>% filter(between(wk2open, -pre_weeks, 47))
  rhs <- c("TP", "treat")
  if (poly_degree >= 1) {
    for (d in seq_len(poly_degree)) {
      if (d == 1) {
        rhs <- c(rhs, "wk2open_pre_treat", "wk2open_post_treat")
      } else {
        rhs <- c(
          rhs,
          paste0("wk2open", d, "_pre_treat"),
          paste0("wk2open", d, "_post_treat")
        )
      }
    }
  }
  fml <- as.formula(
    paste0(
      "lnspd_res ~ ", paste(rhs, collapse = " + "),
      " | linkid + case_wk2open + yrwk[lnpop] + yrwk[lngdppc]"
    )
  )
  feols(fml, cluster = ~case, data = data_use)
}

tab4_mod1 <- run_tab4(tab4_data, pre_weeks = 12, poly_degree = 0)
tab4_mod2 <- run_tab4(tab4_data, pre_weeks = 24, poly_degree = 0)
tab4_mod3 <- run_tab4(tab4_data, pre_weeks = 48, poly_degree = 0)
tab4_mod4 <- run_tab4(tab4_data, pre_weeks = 48, poly_degree = 1)
tab4_mod5 <- run_tab4(tab4_data, pre_weeks = 48, poly_degree = 3)
tab4_mod6 <- run_tab4(tab4_data, pre_weeks = 48, poly_degree = 5)

tab4_models <- list(tab4_mod1, tab4_mod2, tab4_mod3, tab4_mod4, tab4_mod5, tab4_mod6)
fmt_coef <- function(m) sprintf("%.3f", coef(m)[["TP"]])
fmt_se <- function(m) sprintf("(%.3f)", sqrt(vcov(m)[["TP", "TP"]]))
fmt_n <- function(m) formatC(nobs(m), format = "d", big.mark = ",")

table4 <- tibble::tibble(
  term = c(
    "Treated × post",
    "",
    "Range of weeks relative to opening",
    "Polynomial of time trends",
    "",
    "Observations"
  ),
  `1` = c(fmt_coef(tab4_mod1), fmt_se(tab4_mod1), "[-12, 47]", "None", "", fmt_n(tab4_mod1)),
  `2` = c(fmt_coef(tab4_mod2), fmt_se(tab4_mod2), "[-24, 47]", "None", "", fmt_n(tab4_mod2)),
  `3` = c(fmt_coef(tab4_mod3), fmt_se(tab4_mod3), "[-48, 47]", "None", "", fmt_n(tab4_mod3)),
  `4` = c(fmt_coef(tab4_mod4), fmt_se(tab4_mod4), "[-48, 47]", "Linear", "", fmt_n(tab4_mod4)),
  `5` = c(fmt_coef(tab4_mod5), fmt_se(tab4_mod5), "[-48, 47]", "Up to third", "", fmt_n(tab4_mod5)),
  `6` = c(fmt_coef(tab4_mod6), fmt_se(tab4_mod6), "[-48, 47]", "Up to fifth", "", fmt_n(tab4_mod6))
)

kbl(
  table4,
  format = "html",
  align = c("l", rep("c", 6)),
  col.names = c("", "(1)", "(2)", "(3)", "(4)", "(5)", "(6)"),
  escape = FALSE,
  caption = "Table 4—Varying the Length of the Pre-Period",
  table.attr = 'class="table4-original"'
) %>%
  add_header_above(c(" " = 1, "Length of pre-periods\nNumber of weeks before launch" = 3, "Discontinuity around the launch\nTreatment-specific time trend polynomial" = 3)) %>%
  add_header_above(c(" " = 1, "12" = 1, "24" = 1, "48" = 1, "Linear" = 1, "Up to third" = 1, "Up to fifth" = 1)) %>%
  kable_styling(
    full_width = FALSE,
    position = "center",
    bootstrap_options = NULL,
    font_size = 18,
    html_font = "Times New Roman"
  ) %>%
  footnote(
    general = paste0(
      "The dependent variable is a segment's weekly average log residual speed. ",
      "All models are estimated using the stacked DID model and include all 45 treated lines. ",
      "Polynomial of flexible time trends indicates the degree of the polynomials for treatment-specific ",
      "\"pre\" and \"post\" time trends. Standard errors are in parentheses, clustered at the group level."
    ),
    general_title = "Notes:",
    footnote_as_chunk = TRUE,
    escape = FALSE
  )
```

##### Table 5

```{r table5_subsamples_launch, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
# Replikation von ReplicaCodes/Tab5.do
# Laut Replication README ist BaseSamp.dta der Basissample-Datensatz für die meisten Hauptergebnisse.
tab5_data <- read_dta("Data/BaseSamp.dta") %>%
  mutate(
    post = as.numeric(wk2open >= 0),
    TP = treat * post,
    early_lines = as.numeric(opendate <= as.Date("2017-01-31")),
    mid_lines = as.numeric(opendate > as.Date("2017-01-31") & opendate <= as.Date("2017-11-30")),
    late_lines = as.numeric(opendate > as.Date("2017-11-30"))
  )

run_tab5 <- function(data, group = "all") {
  data_use <- switch(
    group,
    all = data %>% filter(between(wk2open, -6, 3)),
    early = data %>% filter(early_lines == 1, between(wk2open, -6, 47)),
    mid = data %>% filter(mid_lines == 1, between(wk2open, -20, 20)),
    late = data %>% filter(late_lines == 1, between(wk2open, -47, 3))
  )
  feols(
    lnspd_res ~ TP + treat | linkid + case_wk2open + yrwk[lnpop] + yrwk[lngdppc],
    cluster = ~case,
    data = data_use
  )
}

tab5_mod1 <- run_tab5(tab5_data, "all")
tab5_mod2 <- run_tab5(tab5_data, "early")
tab5_mod3 <- run_tab5(tab5_data, "mid")
tab5_mod4 <- run_tab5(tab5_data, "late")

tab5_bstrp <- read_dta("TablesFigures/Tab5_Bstrp.dta")
ci95 <- function(x) quantile(x, probs = c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm = TRUE)
ci2 <- ci95(tab5_bstrp$Col2_1)
ci3 <- ci95(tab5_bstrp$Col3_1)
ci4 <- ci95(tab5_bstrp$Col4_1)

fmt_coef <- function(m) sprintf("%.3f", coef(m)[["TP"]])
fmt_se <- function(m) sprintf("(%.3f)", sqrt(vcov(m)[["TP", "TP"]]))
fmt_ci <- function(ci) sprintf("[%.3f, %.3f]", ci[1], ci[2])
fmt_n <- function(m) formatC(nobs(m), format = "d", big.mark = ",")
fmt_n_treated <- function(data, var) {
  data %>%
    filter(.data[[var]] == 1, treat == 1) %>%
    summarise(n = n_distinct(case)) %>%
    pull(n)
}

table5 <- tibble::tibble(
  term = c(
    "Treated × post",
    "",
    "Range of weeks relative to opening",
    "Number of treated lines",
    "",
    "Observations"
  ),
  `1` = c(fmt_coef(tab5_mod1), fmt_se(tab5_mod1), "[-6, 3]", "45", "", fmt_n(tab5_mod1)),
  `2` = c(fmt_coef(tab5_mod2), fmt_ci(ci2), "[-6, 47]", as.character(fmt_n_treated(tab5_data, "early_lines")), "", fmt_n(tab5_mod2)),
  `3` = c(fmt_coef(tab5_mod3), fmt_ci(ci3), "[-20, 20]", as.character(fmt_n_treated(tab5_data, "mid_lines")), "", fmt_n(tab5_mod3)),
  `4` = c(fmt_coef(tab5_mod4), fmt_ci(ci4), "[-47, 3]", as.character(fmt_n_treated(tab5_data, "late_lines")), "", fmt_n(tab5_mod4))
)

kbl(
  table5,
  format = "html",
  align = c("l", rep("c", 4)),
  col.names = c("", "All lines<br>(1)", "Before 1/31/17<br>(2)", "2/1/17–11/30/17<br>(3)", "After 12/1/17<br>(4)"),
  escape = FALSE,
  caption = "Table 5—Subsamples by Time of Launch",
  table.attr = 'class="table5-original"'
) %>%
  kable_styling(
    full_width = FALSE,
    position = "center",
    bootstrap_options = NULL,
    font_size = 18,
    html_font = "Times New Roman"
  ) %>%
  footnote(
    general = paste0(
      "The dependent variable is a segment's weekly average log residual speed. ",
      "All models are estimated using the stacked DID model. In column 1, standard errors are in parentheses, ",
      "clustered at the group level. In columns 2 to 4, numbers in brackets are 95 percent confidence intervals ",
      "from 499 repetitions of wild block bootstrapping."
    ),
    general_title = "Notes:",
    footnote_as_chunk = TRUE,
    escape = FALSE
  )
```

##### Figure 4

```{r fig4_data, echo=FALSE, include=FALSE}
# Replikation von ReplicaCodes/Fig4.do
fig4_base <- read_dta("Data/BaseSamp.dta") %>%
  filter(between(wk2open, -48, 47))

# Event-Time-Dummies wie im Stata-Code: Am48-Am2, A0, Ap1-Ap47
for (w in -48:-2) {
  nm <- paste0("Am", abs(w))
  fig4_base[[nm]] <- fig4_base$treat * as.numeric(fig4_base$wk2open == w)
}
fig4_base$A0 <- fig4_base$treat * as.numeric(fig4_base$wk2open == 0)
for (w in 1:47) {
  nm <- paste0("Ap", w)
  fig4_base[[nm]] <- fig4_base$treat * as.numeric(fig4_base$wk2open == w)
}

rhs_fig4 <- c(
  paste0("Am", 48:2),
  "A0",
  paste0("Ap", 1:47),
  "treat"
)

form_fig4 <- as.formula(
  paste0(
    "lnspd_res ~ ",
    paste(rhs_fig4, collapse = " + "),
    " | linkid + case_wk2open + yrwk[lnpop] + yrwk[lngdppc]"
  )
)

mod_fig4 <- feols(form_fig4, cluster = ~case, data = fig4_base)

wk_seq <- -48:47
coef_val <- rep(NA_real_, length(wk_seq))
se_val <- rep(NA_real_, length(wk_seq))

for (i in seq_along(wk_seq)) {
  w <- wk_seq[i]
  if (w <= -2) {
    nm <- paste0("Am", abs(w))
    coef_val[i] <- unname(coef(mod_fig4)[nm])
    se_val[i] <- sqrt(vcov(mod_fig4)[nm, nm])
  } else if (w == -1) {
    coef_val[i] <- 0
    se_val[i] <- 0
  } else if (w == 0) {
    coef_val[i] <- unname(coef(mod_fig4)["A0"])
    se_val[i] <- sqrt(vcov(mod_fig4)["A0", "A0"])
  } else {
    nm <- paste0("Ap", w)
    coef_val[i] <- unname(coef(mod_fig4)[nm])
    se_val[i] <- sqrt(vcov(mod_fig4)[nm, nm])
  }
}

fig4_df <- tibble(
  wk2open = wk_seq,
  coef = coef_val,
  se = se_val,
  lo = coef - 1.96 * se,
  hi = coef + 1.96 * se
)
```

```{r fig4_plot, echo=FALSE}
# Darstellung analog zu Figure 4 (Longer Pre-Treatment Periods)
p_fig4 <- ggplot(fig4_df, aes(x = wk2open, y = coef)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(-0.05, 0, 0.05, 0.10), color = "#B0B4B8", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi), width = 0, color = "#6d8d84", linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_point(shape = 16, size = 2.3, color = "#6d8d84") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "#90343a", linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(-48, 48, by = 4), limits = c(-48, 48)) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = c(-0.05, 0, 0.05, 0.10),
    limits = c(-0.065, 0.105),
    labels = c("-0.05", "0", "0.05", "0.1")
  ) +
  labs(x = "Weeks to subway opening", y = "Coefficient") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "#3A3A3A", linewidth = 0.7),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "#3A3A3A", linewidth = 0.6),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )

p_fig4
```
